section_header: INTRODUCTION — Vehicle Lift and Support Locations
title: VEHICLE LIFT AND SUPPORT LOCATIONS

content.description: Top-down view of vehicle showing lift and support points. The diagram shows a schematic overhead view of the vehicle chassis with crosshatched circles indicating jack positions at the center of crossmember (front) and center of rear axle housing (rear). Striped semicircles indicate safety stand support positions on both sides of the vehicle.

Side view illustrations showing proper jack and safety stand placement on both front and rear of vehicle. Left illustration shows front wheel area with jack positioned at seam notches. Right illustration shows rear wheel area with jack positioned at seam notches.
